name: SEO Factory
description: Continuous SEO for any website or SaaS: describe the site once, connect Search Console, Google Trends and a mailbox, audit it, then let a scheduled agent improve it every few days — pull requests when the site lives in a Git repository, ready-to-paste recommendations in Google Slides when it runs on a CMS, and one-shot audits of any site delivered as an Excel workbook. A content plan turns search demand into N articles at the pace the owner chooses, each validated before publication — pull request, CMS draft (WordPress, Drupal, Contentful, Strapi, Webflow, Ghost, custom API) or Markdown to paste. Every action is tracked on a GitHub board, a Jira project or a shared Google Sheet, owners get a weekly email of what waits for them, and labeling an issue claude:fix gets it fixed in a pull request.
